678-2921-5865.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat.

443-4279-4699--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-4279-4699--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

579-2113-3995.description:

Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.

When the artifact enters as an Equipment, either because it is an Equipment or due to Bludgeon Brawl, its living weapon ability given by it to Ekthi triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Repeat step 2.

Repeat.

670-1619-3122-3734.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-3734.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Undercover Operative and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-3734.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2173-2842-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Arcbound Slith by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Slith leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Slith
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Slith when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Slith and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

Cast Rhys by paying {1}{W}

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Rhys.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, its ability and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rhys from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.

When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve the Plundering Pirate trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2203-2366-5295-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-5295-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

104-3490-4268-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

224-1671-3314-3430-6763.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {G} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-1671-3314-3430-6763.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-4147-4215-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4147-4215-6798.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3859-5554-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
3859-5554-6441.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {U}{B}.

When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{B}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3334-3933-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.

Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

Mobile Garrison is a creature.

Declare Mobile Garrison and Najeela, if able, as attackers.
Mobile Garrison triggers, as well as Najeela if it was declared an attacker.
Resolve the Mobile Garrison trigger, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, if applicable, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
The Great Whale token enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Anoint, returning it to your hand.

If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

1692-3039-3258-4450.easyPrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Carth the Lion.
1692-3039-3258-4450.description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary copy of Carth the Lion with haste.
After combat, cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Beacon of Tomorrows during your draw step.
Repeat, adding additional loyalty counters on Liliana Vess during step 3 as you accumulate copies of Carth the Lion.

1636-4995.notablePrerequisites:
Belisarius Cawl does not have summoning sickness.

1636-4995.description:

The Astartes Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

651-2603-3140.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve Soltari Guerrillas's ability, causing the next one combat damage dealt by Soltari Guerrillas to an opponent this turn to be dealt to Task Force instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
